# lernapps.net

> lernapps.net is a home for small, free learning apps for school. Every app runs in the browser, needs no account
> and no installation, and collects nothing. Teachers, parents and students build such apps with their AI assistant;
> lernapps.net gives them the guidance and the checks, and lists the apps in a catalog for teachers and parents.

There are three paths: build an app, list an app in the catalog, check an app. Each section below lists what you
need, in the order you need it. The workflow itself is in the plan template; follow it exactly.

## Build an app

- [Plan template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-template.md): the workflow, from the first question to the listing, with the creator's checkpoints. Save it as `.vibe/plan.md` in an empty folder and follow it.
- [Skill lernapps-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/SKILL.md): the rules every app follows. Install it with `npx skills add lernapps/tooling`.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/AGENTS.md): what always holds in an app repo. The generator writes it into the app.
- [Create the app](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling#the-generator), after the creator has confirmed the plan: `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main create --archetype <archetype>`, then `git init` if needed and `npm install`. It needs github.com, codeload.github.com and the npm registry.
- [Rule catalog](https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/): every rule by id. Check messages link here.

## List an app in the catalog

- [Listing guide](https://lernapps.net/apps/llms.txt): the conditions, the entry and the pull request to lernapps/apps.
- [Entry schema](https://lernapps.net/apps/schemas/entry.v1.schema.json): what the entry holds; its descriptions say what each field needs.
- [Rule catalog](https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/): the rules of scope `listing` are the conditions for a listing.
- [Check the entry against the app](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling#the-package-lernappstooling): `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main check --entry <file>`.
- [Plan template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-template.md): for an app built with it, its Commit phase holds the listing steps.

## Check an app

- [Check command](https://github.com/lernapps/tooling#the-package-lernappstooling): `npx lernapps check` in an app from the generator, the same as its git hooks and CI. For an app built any other way: `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main check <dir|url>`.
- [Rule catalog](https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/): what each finding means and how to fix it.
- [Validation report schema](https://lernapps.net/tooling/schemas/validation-report.v1.schema.json): what the check reports, in YAML.
- [Skill lernapps-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/SKILL.md): the rules no program checks.

## Optional

- [Tooling for AI assistants](https://lernapps.net/tooling/llms.txt): all commands, skills, schemas, the review procedure and the archetypes.
- [The catalog](https://lernapps.net/apps/): all listed apps.
- [Platform design](https://lernapps.net/docs/platform-design/): how lernapps.net works as a platform.
- [Vision](https://lernapps.net/docs/vision/): why lernapps.net exists.
